158.named_note: All printed poet/addressee and source-note names/collective references are retained as source mentions only; frozen punctuation anomalies are preserved and no external historical identity resolution is made.

landscape_environment.note: Mountain, waterfall, cave/summit and cultivated/forested hill imagery are explicit landscape evidence.

flora.note: Garland/flower and jackfruit/bamboo-like hill vegetation are retained as source flora.

fauna.note: Horse and monkey are retained as source fauna.

people_social_roles.note: Rulers/patrons, singer/poet, petitioners and current patron are retained as source roles.

relationships.note: The chain of remembered patrons, petitioners and current appeal is explicit relationship evidence.

emotion_lived_experience.note: Eager recollection, distress of those who come, and the speaker's urgent arrival are explicit lived experience.

clothing_ornaments_adornment.note: Garland and ornate dress/weapon epithet are retained as adornment evidence.

material_culture_everyday_objects.note: Drum, spear/ornament and weapon are explicit material objects.

weapons_warfare.note: War with rulers, spear, battle victory, driving off enemies and final spear are explicit warfare evidence.

mobility_transport.note: Riding, horse and chariot are explicit mobility evidence.

economy.note: Generosity to those who come and relieving supplicants' want are explicit patronage evidence.

polity_political_life.note: Named rulers/patrons, territory and conflict are retained as source polity evidence without external resolution.

communities_social_groups.note: `பாடி வருநர்`, others and supplicants are retained as source social/literary groups.

religion_ritual.note: `அருந்திறல் கடவுள் காக்கும் உயர்சிமை` is explicit religious/sacral landscape evidence without doctrinal expansion.

death_mourning_memory.note: Remembered earlier patrons and explicit `எழுவர் மாய்ந்த பின்றை` are retained as death/memory evidence.

arts_music_performance.note: Drum, `மோசி பாடிய`, and singers are explicit performance/intertextual evidence.

values_ethical_concepts.note: Generosity, relief of distress, fame and victory are explicit evaluative/praise evidence.

textual_intertextual_relationships.note: `மோசி பாடிய ஆயும்` explicitly references another poet's praise; the source note separately preserves alternative `பரிசில் கடாநிலையும் ஆம்` and `எழுவர் வள்ளல்கள்` context.
